newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo to shift more into pharma, coatings.
newsitem.headline: Akzo to shift more into pharma, coatings.

text.p: Chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Wednesday it would continue to shift the emphasis of its activities towards high-margin pharmaceuticals and coatings in its drive to achieve a 20 percent return on investment.
"It is clearly our strategy to become more of a pharma and coatings company," outgoing finance director Syb Bergsma told a news conference on the company's third quarter results.
"That's where the growth has to come from, these are the areas of higher margins."
Akzo Nobel earlier reported third quarter net profits edged up to 328 million guilders from a year-earlier 324 million.

He said Akzo was targeting a return on investment (ROI) for the company as a whole of 20 percent. "This will happen through the shift into coatings and pharma...Now (ROI) is about 16 percent," Bergsma said.
Akzo Nobel's fibres business would not achieve a 20 percent return on investment, but this would be offset by pharma, where returns were higher than the target, he said.
Coatings and pharma generated some two-thirds of group operating profit in the first nine months of this year and a hefty 80 percent in the third quarter, Bergsma said.
